units.source_text: 有一天闲静的月夜，源氏公子眺望澄碧无际的海面，

en.t: One quiet moonlit night, Prince Genji gazed out over the clear blue sea stretching endlessly before him,

units.source_text: 觉得很像从前住惯的二条院庭中的池塘，

en.t: and felt that it closely resembled the pond in the garden of the Nijo residence where he had once lived so familiarly,
so an immeasurable longing for home welled up in his heart.

units.source_text: 然而寂寞寡欢，无以自慰，

en.t: Yet he was lonely and joyless, with nothing to comfort himself,

units.source_text: 眼前望见的只是一个淡路岛。

en.t: and all he could see before his eyes was the single island of Awaji.

units.source_text: 便吟唱古歌：“昔居淡路岛，遥遥望月宫。

en.t: He then chanted an old poem: "Long ago I lived on Awaji Island, gazing from afar toward the palace of the moon.

units.source_text: 今宵月近身，莫非境不同。”

en.t: Tonight the moon is close beside me; can it be that I am in a different realm?"
He also composed a poem, saying:
